newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE to aim for 4,270 then may slip back.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE to aim for 4,270 then may slip back.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may stretch up to 4,270 in early trading but without much buying interest, a slippage from there could then take it back to around 4,255 later in the day, technical analysts said.
Strength from the consumer goods sector which includes household and pharmaceuticals companies will help lead the market higher as well as recovery from financial groups, they added.
But the thrills and spills from Tuesday has unnerved investors making it tough for the market to make rapid progress.
By 0722 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 9.6 at 4,257.7.
Yesterday's crawl up from an intra-day low from 4,200 should ensure a reasonably firm start today but for the moment this may still be nothing more than a rally in a downtrend, analysts said.

If market bulls are to regain the initiative, they need to find a way above trendline resistance at 4,290 -- a level which was derived from a descending trendline connecting the FTSE's intra-day highs since March 11 when it reached 4,466.3.
But a swift rise by the FTSE today may yet be derailed by stale bulls seizing the opportunity to cut their losses after the market's recent decline.
A subsequent rebound from 4,255 today from bargain hunters unwilling to accept that the market is currently in a downtrend is possible -- but only with the support of Wall Street.
On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average notched up 27.57 points, closing at 6,611.05.
